offering_description.value: Organizes trade shows and conferences where suppliers exhibit, meet buyers and sponsor programs. It also publishes industry media and offers online wholesale ordering tools for brands and retailers.

primary_products.value: wholesale ordering software; industry trade publications

primary_services.value: trade show and conference organization; event sponsorship and promotion; industry publishing and advertising

customer_segment.value: B2B: brands, manufacturers, wholesalers, retailers, trade professionals and advertisers; B2C: attendees at consumer events such as outdoor recreation expos

end_markets.value: retail and wholesale trade; design and construction; outdoor recreation; technology; hospitality and travel

revenue_model.value: service fees: exhibit space and event registration; advertising: event sponsorships and trade media placements; subscription: access to wholesale ordering software

value_chain_position.value: service provider: assembles venues, exhibitors and programs for trade buyers and attendees, and publishes industry coverage for professionals; software / platform: hosts supplier catalogs and connects brands with retailers for wholesale ordering

geography_served.value: global: primarily United States, with events in the United Kingdom and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: trade shows, conferences, industry media and wholesale ordering software

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams serving exhibitors, sponsors, advertisers and software customers; online: event registration websites, trade media sites and wholesale ordering portals; other: third-party convention centers and other event venues

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: in-person events follow local fire, occupancy and accessibility rules, and attendee data is subject to privacy laws

notes: The current lineup of smaller digital offerings and the full international event footprint are uncertain.
